errors.text_span: всяка линия е свързана с различна скала на оста Y
errors.evidence: The figure has two Y-axes: the blue SOFIX line uses the left axis, while the red BG40 and green BGBX40 lines share the right axis. It is not the case that each line has a different Y-axis scale.
The green BGBX40 line starts around 120 points near 2014, not around 50 points in 2001.

errors.text_span: През 2015 г. индексът достига около 100 точки
errors.evidence: The green BGBX40 line is already around 100–120 points when it first appears and is closer to about 90–110 around 2015; the described value and timing are inaccurate.
The green BGBX40 line ends closer to about 130 points in 2021, not 150.

The description says all three lines are solid and without markers, but it does not mention the line styles/color details from the legend in a structured way for each series beyond naming them; however this is largely covered and only minor stylistic detail is omitted.
